THIS TREE IS THAT MECHANISM ALONE: branched from 94f81e5 (exp-0026, the last ACCEPTED tip, 514.2 tok/s) and cherry-picking only exp-0028's two engine commits, which touch a disjoint file set (kernels/moe_shared.py + the model.moe_shared call site). kernels/moe_out.py is ABSENT from the tree and _FUSED_OUT appears nowhere in it, so the faulting path is gone; `git diff --stat 94f81e5 HEAD -- engine/` is exactly moe_shared.py (new), model.py (+27/-2) and three test files. MECHANISM: model.moe_shared was the last bring-up-era eager chain on the MoE block, on all 64 MoE layers in both phases. Its two elementwise chains around the down GEMM — `silu(gate)*up*g` as three passes and `.float().sum(0).to(bf16)` as three more — move ~1.30 GB of HBM per layer at the in-situ cohort against 354 MB fused, i.e. ~944 MB/layer that exists only to carry values between elementwise kernels (~60 GB per prefill traversal to produce a 59 MB result), on devices exp-0023's DEADENDS finding 1 shows are SATURATED during prefill. The fused form is BITWISE equal, not envelope-covered: aten's silu on a bf16 input is x/(1+expf(-x)) in fp32 opmath with one bf16 round, the two multiplies are torch's fp32-opmath bf16 multiplies in Python's left-to-right order, and `.float().sum(dim=0)` over n_shared=2 has no reduction order to choose. Kill switch PYENGINE_FUSED_SHARED=0 restores the eager chain verbatim. EVIDENCE. (1) Isolated, exp-0028's own arms (tests/t_fused_shared, log /workspace/logs/t_fused_shared_exp0028_out.log): bitwise at both phases' shapes, 0 of 29,491,200 and 0 of 393,216 elements, max|d| exactly 0; epilogue pair 0.399 -> 0.064 ms/layer (3.17 -> 5.39 TB/s) = 6.2x. (2) In situ on the real resident model, interleaved arms (tests/t_fused_shared_insitu, log /workspace/logs/t_fused_shared_insitu_exp0028_out.log): prefill step 0.620 -> 0.521 s (-99 ms), mixed step 0.998 -> 0.955 s (-44 ms), decode 69.2 -> 68.2 ms, schedule 1.087x, token streams EQUAL across arms, run1 == run2 bitwise on both arms. (3) NEW THIS ITERATION, and it is the arm exp-0027 died for want of (tests/t_fused_shared_cohort, GPU 7, CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1, log /workspace/logs/t_fused_shared_cohort_exp0029_out.log): both kernels launched at EVERY prefill group shape the scheduler can actually form — B = min(64, PREFILL_SCORES_BUDGET/(128*Tmax^2)) over Tmax in [512, 1536], i.e. M = B*Tmax from 4,800 up to 46,336, act grids up to (92672, 3) — arm a no fault at any shape, arm b BITWISE at every shape (0 of 284,688,384 elements at the largest), arm c two identical launches bitwise equal. Both kernels carry their offsets in int64 (`row.to(tl.int64) * F`), so the arithmetic that would break at scale is not present. The same sweep run against exp-0027's epilogue (tests/t_moe_out_cohort, log /workspace/logs/t_moe_out_cohort_exp0029_out.log) is ALSO clean, which is why the post-mortem convicts the surrounding layer rather than that kernel and why exp-0027 is not resubmitted here.
